scope: Teacher reporting reliability; independent of lint cleanup PR #6. No production, database, policy, index or stored-data changes.

confirmed_causes.cause: Dashboard and LiveClassPanel requested full class event history without time bounds or explicit pagination. Poll, focus and realtime refresh triggers could overlap.
confirmed_causes.change: Seven-day event window, fixed upper timestamp, 250-row keyset pages, refresh leases and stale-class rejection. Keep last successful event/attempt results when fetching fails and show an availability notice.

confirmed_causes.cause: Year2LessonEngine sent questionsAnswered + 1 as attemptNumber; active cards displayed that telemetry field.
confirmed_causes.change: Remove question-derived attempt telemetry. Derive lesson/quiz labels from matching saved attempt numbers: latest saved for completed runs, next number for active runs. Explicitly page saved attempts without the event-history cutoff; unavailable history does not fabricate Attempt 1.

confirmed_causes.cause: PracticeRunner/Year2LessonEngine finished effects and the lesson route both emitted lesson_completed. Effect reruns could emit again.
confirmed_causes.change: Lesson route owns completion telemetry; standalone runners retain a one-shot emitter. Route adds existing session identity as completionKey. Timeline collapses only explicit same-identity completion events; legacy ambiguous records and genuine retries remain.

coverage: Compound timestamp/id pagination, equal timestamps, API caps, mid-fetch inserts and class filtering
Empty results, page failures and cancellation
Refresh overlap, class switching, stale responses, failure retry and unmount invalidation
Actual dashboard refresh function with deferred mock responses
Actual card functions: canonical attempts, reloads, question-count stability, genuine retries and saved completed scores
Completion emitter ownership, effect replay and explicit-identity deduplication

validation.application_lint: 65 errors and 320 warnings; final rerun matches clean base main diagnostic set exactly. No new diagnostics. Existing failures remain visible.

limitations: No production query timing or signed-in browser verification of this branch. Mocked query tests do not prove PostgreSQL query plans or RLS performance.
Seven-day event history supports recent reporting; canonical saved attempts/progress remain separate and retain historical coverage. Large classes may still require many bounded pages.
Existing duplicate timeline events lacking completion identity are not removed or heuristically hidden.
React effect tests execute real effect fragments with a test harness; they are not a full browser lifecycle test.
PR #6 lint fixes are deliberately excluded. Required checks must not be bypassed.
release_verification: Use an approved disposable student and authorised teacher: begin, answer, reload, complete and retry a lesson; verify stable attempt number and one new completion entry.
Verify saved scores, week unlocks and teacher progress after reload; switch classes during refresh and trigger focus/poll/realtime updates.
Measure history requests for a production-sized class, confirm explicit bounds/pages and absence of statement timeouts.
Review and integrate independently after required CI checks pass; no automatic merge or deployment.
rollback: Revert this code commit. No database rollback or historical data repair is required.
